facts.value: ERASMUS stands for EuRopean community Action Scheme for the Mobility of University Students.

metadata.chunk_title: ERASMUS

facts.value: The ERASMUS programme was originally established as the SOCRATES programme in 1987.

metadata.chunk_title: ERASMUS

facts.value: It has proved to be one of the most successful projects of the European Union and now offers a wider range of opportunities under the new Erasmus+ programme.

metadata.chunk_title: ERASMUS

facts.value: The main aim of the Erasmus+ programme is to improve students' skills and ultimately their employability as well as to support the modernisation of education and training systems across Europe.

metadata.chunk_title: ERASMUS

facts.value: The programme is highly rated by employers.

metadata.chunk_title: ERASMUS

facts.value: A recent Erasmus+ Impact Study shows that the programme enhances students’ employability abroad, improves transferable skills and enhances career development.
